summary.text: Ross Berry is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 44, where he assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his priorities are lower taxes, a lower cost of living, individual freedom and safe communities.

paragraphs.text: Ross Berry lives in Weare, New Hampshire, and earned a B.A. in economics and political science from the University of the South, Sewanee.
His career experience includes working as president of RevT Strategies, executive director of the New Hampshire Republican State Committee, and Virginia data director with the GOP.
In the survey, he described himself as a small-business owner who operates two local childcare centers with his wife.
Berry previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2020 to 2024, and he chaired the Election Law Committee in 2023-2024.
He said in the survey that he has chaired that committee for four years and previously chaired the Special Committee on Childcare.
He listed energy, election law and finance as policy areas he is passionate about.
